pressOrOkToEdit: Press ▼ or OK to edit settings.

warn.language: ⚠ Work in progress: only English is fully translated. Any other language leaves large parts of the game untranslated.
warn.cardCombat: ⚠ Replaces the standard battle scene. Turning this on turns Map Battle off.
warn.mapBattleMode: ⚠ Replaces the standard battle scene. Turning this on turns Card Combat off.

desc.enemySpawnMode: Decides how strong the enemies wandering the world are.
desc.weatherVolume: Scales the outdoor ambience: rain, storms, wind, the night chorus and the ambient bed of the biome you are standing in. It rides on top of the BGS volume, and leaves interiors and a map's own authored sounds alone.

enemySpawnMode: Balanced: enemies match your party. Roamers stay at or below your level, and each world tile hides one boss well above it.
Realistic: your level is ignored. The danger comes from the place itself, wilder biomes and the distance from the Omega Tower, so far lands can be lethal early.
